latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle Browser 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Enables uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) and adding AI-generated subtitles.
- Connects automatically to cloud processing; generates temporary authentication tokens if needed.
- Supports subtitle, audio track, aspect ratio, and overlay editing with cloud GPU-accelerated rendering.
- Exports processed videos as 1080p MP4 files in about 30–60 seconds.
- Includes session management, live status updates, and clear error handling and user feedback.
- Supports multi-language subtitles and batch processing for multiple files per session.
